title: Horror novel reportedly pulled from publication after suspected use of AI during writing process | The Independent
summary: Hachette Book Group pulled the AI-generated horror novel 'Shy Girl' by Mia Ballard after widespread accusations and online backlash. The book, which explores themes of captivity and female rage, will no longer be published or available on major platforms.
sentiment_reason: The decision to pull the book due to AI-generated content and the controversy surrounding it indicates a strong negative market impact.
